summary: Checked 38 concrete claims (files, classes, methods, fields, enum members, config props, frontend symbols, claimed-absent items). All confirmed against live code. No code mirages. Two minor wording nuances noted below at low severity; neither blocks implementation.

findings.claim: Decision 5 / code-research: name collision with `Button.targetStepId` (described as an existing field that the generic edge-pass `requireExistingTarget` would pick up).
findings.reality: Confirmed-and-correct on substance, minor imprecision in phrasing. `targetStepId` lives on the Button (ButtonDto.java:15 as record accessor `targetStepId()`, validated at FunnelService.java:696). FunnelStep itself has NO `targetStepId` field (it has `timeoutTargetStepId`, FunnelStep.java:31). The generic edge-pass at FunnelService.java:666-667 only feeds `step.getNext()` and `step.getTimeoutTargetStepId()` — it does NOT feed any step-level `targetStepId`, so a new flat `targetEntryStepId` field is auto-excluded as the spec intends. The collision is a naming/semantic confusion concern, not a literal edge-pass conflict on FunnelStep. The chosen name `targetEntryStepId` is sound.

findings.claim: code-research cites `FunnelService.validateSteps` switch at `:648` and `isMessageStep` at `:386-388`; the `onSubmit` submit-case at FunnelStepForm.vue `:427`.
findings.reality: Line numbers drifted slightly from current HEAD but symbols are all present and correct: validateSteps switch at FunnelService.java:648 (exact match), isMessageStep at FunnelService.java:386, validateSteps signature at :633. onSubmit is `handleSubmit((values) => ...)` at FunnelStepForm.vue:424 (cited :424-491 — matches; the inner per-type case-switch is inside this handler). No functional mismatch.
